description:
Two crates declare Cargo features that are not described anywhere in user-facing docs:

- jmap-mail-types/Cargo.toml: `mdn = []`, `sieve = []`
- jmap-mail-server/Cargo.toml: `mdn = ["jmap-mail-types/mdn"]`, `sieve = ["jmap-mail-types/sieve"]`

Neither README documents what the features enable, what RFC they correspond to (RFC 9007 / RFC 9661), or how to opt in.

crates.io renders feature flags on the package page but users still expect README guidance.

Related to JMAP-sc1b.X (mail-types README) and JMAP-sc1b.X (mail-server README) — fold this into those if more efficient, or keep separate as a feature-flag-doc consistency item.
title: P2: mdn and sieve Cargo features declared but undocumented in any README
